name: Azuma Suzuna
source:
She is the second daughter of the Azuma family. She is a third-year student at St. Orkis Academy, where she is the student body president. She is very popular in the school because of her good-natured personality and sincere attitude toward everyone. She is more attached to the school than anyone else because her late father, who was a teacher, also loved the school. She believes that the current trend of female chauvinism is excessive, but from the standpoint of a student, she is troubled by the difficulty of improving the situation.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/17th/seidorei2/]official site[/url]]
